Save CDR plots to PDF or raster images

save_cdrgam_plots.Rd

Open a graphics device, call plot.cdrgam(), and close the device. PDF output may contain multiple pages. Raster output inserts a numbered format field before the extension when more than one page is requested.

Usage

save_cdrgam_plots(
  object,
  file,
  device = c("auto", "pdf", "png", "jpeg", "tiff"),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 144,
  pages = 1,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted cdrgam model.

file

Output path.

device

Output device. "auto" uses the file extension.

width, height

Device dimensions in inches.

dpi

Raster resolution.

pages

Number of output pages passed to plot.cdrgam().

...

Additional arguments passed to plot.cdrgam().

Value

Invisibly, the plot-data object returned by plot.cdrgam().
